0022600092.text: Both the Phoenix Suns and Portland Trail Blazers open their 2026-27 seasons in this matchup, with the Suns on the road. The Suns won the 2025-26 season series 2-1, though Phoenix lost 92-77 in the most recent meeting, a February 22 regular season game in Phoenix. Phoenix is without Luke Kennard (knee strain) and Mark Williams (shoulder surgery), while Portland is missing Branden Carlson (concussion), Chris Youngblood (ankle soreness), and Shaedon Sharpe (knee surgery), and Micah Potter is day-to-day with an illness and is a game-time decision.
